title: Brick Kart
description: A Mario Kart-style racer built from LEGO-style bricks: 13 big maps in 4 cups, including a Movie Cup with Jurassic World, Star Wars, Marvel and Jujutsu Kaisen tracks full of brick-built characters. Gliders, hazards, 16 racers with 13 per race, 23 power-ups, drifting mini-turbos, and 1-4 player split-screen with controller support.
